subtopics.name: Types of Drama
objectives: Identify types of drama: tragedy, comedy, tragicomedy, farce, melodrama and opera
Describe the distinguishing features of each type of drama
Classify plays according to their dramatic types

subtopics.name: Dramatic Techniques and Elements
objectives: Identify elements of drama: plot, character, dialogue, setting, theme, spectacle
Explain dramatic techniques: soliloquy, aside, dramatic irony, flashback, suspense, comic relief
Explain the structure of a play: acts, scenes, exposition, climax, denouement
Distinguish between protagonist, antagonist, foil and other character roles

subtopics.name: Prescribed Drama Texts (African and Non-African)
objectives: Analyse the plot, setting and structure of the prescribed African and non-African plays
Discuss the themes and characterization in the prescribed plays
Identify and illustrate the dramatic techniques used in the prescribed plays

subtopics.name: Types of Prose
objectives: Distinguish between fiction (novel, novella, short story) and non-fiction (biography, autobiography, memoir, essay)
Identify types of the novel: picaresque, epistolary, gothic, historical, bildungsroman
Describe the distinguishing features of each prose type

subtopics.name: Narrative Techniques and Elements of Prose
objectives: Identify elements of prose: plot, character, setting, theme, style
Explain narrative points of view: first person, third person, omniscient
Explain narrative techniques: flashback, foreshadowing, stream of consciousness, irony
Explain methods of characterization in prose

subtopics.name: Prescribed Prose Texts (African and Non-African)
objectives: Analyse the plot, setting and narrative techniques of the prescribed African and non-African novels
Discuss the themes and characterization in the prescribed novels
Relate the prescribed texts to their social and cultural contexts

subtopics.name: Types of Poetry
objectives: Identify types of poetry: sonnet, ode, elegy, ballad, epic, lyric, panegyric, blank verse, didactic poetry
Describe the distinguishing features of each poetic type
Classify given poems according to type

subtopics.name: Poetic Devices and Structure
objectives: Identify sound devices: rhyme, rhythm, metre, alliteration, assonance, onomatopoeia, repetition, refrain
Identify structural elements: stanza, couplet, quatrain, sestet, octave, verse, enjambment, caesura
Explain imagery, symbolism, mood, tone and diction in poetry

subtopics.name: Prescribed Poetry Texts (African and Non-African)
objectives: Analyse the subject matter, themes and settings of the prescribed African and non-African poems
Identify and illustrate the poetic devices used in the prescribed poems
Discuss the poets' moods, tones and messages

subtopics.name: Figures of Speech and Literary Devices
objectives: Identify and illustrate figures of speech: simile, metaphor, personification, hyperbole, irony, paradox, oxymoron, euphemism, litotes, metonymy, synecdoche, apostrophe
Distinguish between commonly confused figures of speech
Interpret the effects of literary devices in given passages

subtopics.name: Literary Terms, Genres and Traditions
objectives: Define common literary terms (motif, allusion, satire, allegory, epigram, catharsis, hubris, poetic justice, poetic licence)
Distinguish between the three major genres of literature and their features
Explain oral literature: folktales, proverbs, myths, legends and their features
Identify literary periods and movements (classical, romantic, modern, African literature)

subtopics.name: Appreciation of Unseen Prose Passages
objectives: Read and interpret unseen prose passages
Identify the theme, tone, mood, setting and point of view of unseen prose
Identify the literary devices used in unseen prose passages
Deduce meanings of words and expressions in context

subtopics.name: Appreciation of Unseen Poetry
objectives: Read and interpret unseen poems
Identify the subject matter, theme, mood, tone and persona of unseen poems
Identify the poetic devices used in unseen poems

subtopics.name: Appreciation of Unseen Drama Excerpts
objectives: Read and interpret unseen dramatic excerpts
Identify dramatic techniques, character traits and themes in unseen excerpts
